explanatory_strength.rationale: The upcycle-to-capex-to-dilution mechanism is filing-grounded and falsifiable, but industry supply response versus a durable datacenter mix shift is not yet distinguished.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: Company capex, cash, concentration, and normalized owner-cash bridges are anchored in SEC filings, yet industry capacity additions, utilization, and mid-cycle unit margins are not measured.

downside_control.rationale: Q1 2026 cash of $439.7M helps, but 82% revenue from two customers, ongoing Taiwan build-out, and 60M-to-76M share dilution can overwhelm the bounded cycle reserve.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: At $99.77 the base Lawrence path is -13.4% per year and the contract mid-cycle sum is ~$16/sh; even the bull scenario stays below a portfolio hurdle.

claims.claim: FY2025 capital spending was $179.1M versus $174.4M operating cash flow; normalized owner cash of $0.74 per share assumes capex falls to $130M after Taiwan build-out.
Digicomm and Microsoft together accounted for roughly 82% of FY2025 revenue, tying capacity expansion to extreme customer concentration.
Diluted shares rose from 60.2M in FY2025 to 76.0M in Q1 2026 after equity offerings that funded the capacity ramp.

strongest_counter_explanation: The datacenter mix shift to 54% of Q1 2026 revenue and vertical laser integration may sustain above-mid-cycle margins and multi-hyperscaler share gains, making today's price a growth bet rather than peak-cycle capitalization.
most_important_missing_fact: Industry-wide 800G transceiver capacity additions, fab utilization, and mid-cycle unit margin benchmarks are not in the packet, so normalized $0.74 per share free cash flow cannot be verified as mid-cycle rather than still-elevated.
falsifiers: Reported free cash flow exceeds the normalized $0.74 per share path for four consecutive quarters as Taiwan capex normalizes
Top-two customer concentration falls below 70% with documented third hyperscaler volume
Industry utilization and pricing hold for two years while competitor capacity additions stay disciplined
specialist_findings: Filings show equity-funded capacity expansion during an optical upcycle while price embeds roughly 6x the contract mid-cycle component sum; without industry supply and utilization data, returns look like peak-margin capitalization inviting a supply response rather than disciplined mid-cycle economics.
